description.en: Warehouse in Georgetown, Guyana. The asset occupies 20,990 m². The asset is ready to occupy. Title is held freehold under Guyana law. Provision includes outdoor space. The listing has been verified by the XARU HOME desk and its documentation reviewed. This record is platform demonstration inventory: the structure, the workflow and the data model are the production ones, the asset is not.
